get.summary:
Canonical liveness probe: the public HTTP listener serves requests.
Part of the documented probe contract; see the controller README section.
Canonical readiness probe. Part of the documented probe contract.
Canonical startup probe. Part of the documented probe contract.

replayed.description: True when this key already admitted the same request; no second operation exists.

AgentStatusResponse.description:
The agent side: derived from the last check-in, or `no-agent` for a Swarm member that never
checked in.

action.description: start, stop, restart, pause, unpause, or remove.

force.description: Remove only: kill running containers first.

ClusterSummaryResponse.description: Counts by health, manager reachability, quorum, and load over online agents.

cpuPercent.description: Mean over online nodes with a sample; null when there are none.

quorum.description: `healthy` when the manager answers and every manager is ready and reachable.

force.description: Remove only: kill a running container first.

timeoutSeconds.description: Stop and restart only: grace before kill, 0–600 (default 10).

ContainerListResponse.description: `{ items, nodes, snapshotAt }`: merged containers and one outcome per member node.

cpuPercent.description: From the node's last sample; null when not running.

networks.description: Networks it has endpoints on, by name (at most 16).

status.description: Bounded daemon status text, e.g. `Up 3 minutes`.

attachable.description: Overlay only: standalone containers may attach.

driver.description: `overlay` (swarm scope, on the manager) or `bridge` (local, on `nodeId`).

name.description: `[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*`, 1–128 characters, unique across the current list.

nodeId.description: The member node that holds it; volumes are node-local.

nodesOnline.description: Members checking in within 15 s; null when membership could not be read.

nodesTotal.description: Every node that has ever checked in; null when membership could not be read.

FieldErrorResponse.description: A 400 naming the field that failed: `{ "error": "invalid_request", "fields": { field: problem } }`.

sizeBytes.description: Counted once, however many nodes have it.

usedBy.description: Containers using it, summed across nodes.

error.description: Always `invalid_credentials`, for an unknown email and a wrong password alike.

manager.description: `ok`, `not_a_manager`, or `unavailable`: whether swarm-scope rows came from the manager.

containers.description: Running containers attached, summed across nodes.

nodeIds.description: Local: its node. Swarm: the nodes with endpoints on it.

scope.description: `swarm` (one row for the cluster) or `local` (one row per node).

NodeHealthResponse.description: `active` when the agent is online and Swarm says ready; `down` when either says down.

NodeOutcomeResponse.description: Per-node result shared by every fan-out route.

NodeResponse.description: One node: a membership row joined to the manager's Swarm member.

address.description: The address the manager sees the node at.

agentVersion.description: Agent fields are null for a member without an agent.

id.description: The agent's certificate identity; the Swarm node id for a member without an agent.

errorMessage.description: Failure message of a failed operation; never daemon or transport internals.

progress.description: The latest progress or result document for the kind.

requestId.description: The admitting request's id, shown next to failures.

PasswordSessionResponse.description: Issued exactly once per sign-in, with `Cache-Control: no-store`.

reference.description: `[host[:port]/]name[:tag|@digest]`; `:latest` is added when neither is given.

QuorumUnavailableResponse.description: 503 while the manager can't answer; the desktop retries after `retryAfterSeconds`.

codeVerifier.description:
Desktop-held PKCE verifier matching the start challenge. JSON body
only, never a URL.

refreshCredential.description:
Opaque refresh credential. Transported in the JSON body only, never
in a URL, and returned only once at issuance or rotation.

password.description: 12–128 characters. JSON body only; never logged or echoed.

force.description: Remove even while containers use it.

nodeIds.description: Node ids, or `"all"` for every member that has it.

cpuPercent.description: Null when no sample landed in the bucket, never 0.

nodes.description: Nodes that contributed a sample to the bucket.

version.description: The service version the change is based on; a newer one is 409 `version_conflict`.

latestError.description: The newest task error, for the replica tooltip and the scaling status line.

desiredReplicas.description: Replicated: the replicas asked for. Global: one per eligible node.

imageReference.description: The full reference the tasks run, digest included.

version.description: Swarm's object version; writes send it back.

volumesRetained.description: Named volumes the services mount; removal leaves them.

cpuPercent.description: Summed from the stack's running containers' last samples.

runningContainers.description: Tasks running and desired, summed over the stack's services.

codeChallenge.description:
Desktop-generated PKCE S256 challenge. The verifier itself never
crosses this endpoint; only the challenge is persisted.

SwarmNodeStatusResponse.description:
What the manager last heard from the node; `unknown` when it did not answer or does not
know the node.

swarmNodeId.description: Swarm node id (not the Kontainer node id).

sizeBytes.description: From the node's last disk sample; `null` until then or when the driver can't say.

usedBy.description: Containers on the node (any state) that mount it.
